91:1: By the sun and its forenoon.
91:2: And the moon when it follows it.
91:3: And by the day when it reveals it.
91:4: By the night when it covers it.
91:5: And the sky and the one who built it.
91:6: And by the earth and the one who spread it.
91:7: By the soul and the one who arranged it.
91:8: Then He inspired it with its wickedness and its piety.
91:9: Truly, the one who purifies has succeeded.
91:10: And the one who covers it has surely suffered loss.
91:11: Thamud denied because of its transgression.
91:12: When the most wretched of them sprang up.
91:13: The messenger of Allah said to them: The she-camel of Allah and her watering.
91:14: They denied him, then they slaughtered it. And their Rabb destroyed them because of their sins and made them level.
91:15: And He does not fear its consequence.
